name: STRAT (Structured population Association Test)
model_likelihood: Within-subpopulation candidate-locus model: phenotype-independent allele frequencies under H0, phenotype-dependent under H1; individual admixture vectors q represent ancestry.
inference_algorithm: MCMC population-structure inference from the cited earlier method; plug-in ancestry; EM candidate allele-frequency estimates; simulated null significance.
estimand: Candidate-locus within-subpopulation association, summarized by a likelihood-ratio statistic and simulated significance probability.
data_input: Individual-level case-control labels and candidate-locus genotypes; multiple unlinked background marker genotypes.
tunable_settings: Number and selection of background markers; number M of simulated null draws.
